question: Should OpenClaw accept a core `openclaw.clawFeed.v1` local feed inspect/plan surface on top of the still-open Claws stack after the containment bug is fixed?
rationale: The PR creates a new public schema and CLI contract that future ClawHub feed, install, provenance, workspace-file, and automation work will depend on, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Fix and continue maintainer review
options.body: Require the realpath containment repair and real CLI output, then have maintainers explicitly approve the feed schema and command names before merge.

options.title: Hold for the base Claws contract
options.body: Keep this stacked PR draft until the manifest/plan base PR and RFC direction are accepted or narrowed.

options.title: Accept this read-only slice
options.body: Maintainers can sponsor the feed schema and CLI as the compatibility baseline while deferring remote fetch, install, mutation, and publish/search behavior.

recommendation.title: Fix and continue maintainer review
recommendation.body: Require the realpath containment repair and real CLI output, then have maintainers explicitly approve the feed schema and command names before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on the CLI registration and descriptor surfaces that would carry the new public command contract.
